theorems.assumptions: A,B nonsingular rational 6x6; fixed prime p and R>=1; oriented lattice homothety observer
theorems.statement: Equality on the standard lattice, six axis-line lattices and all-ones-line lattice iff equality on every normalized safe lattice of p-spread<R. R=1 needs just the standard probe.
theorems.boundary: No claim of minimum probe count or immediate risk inequality from unequal output lattices.

theorems.assumptions: Same as SD-001; shared canonical projective lattice codec
theorems.statement: Canonical image H(A) plus projectivized unit factor H(A)^-1 p^-min(A) A mod p^(R-1) exactly classifies all-safe oriented actions.
theorems.boundary: Not a fixed-bit compression; not a minimal HIT-only quotient.

theorems.name_zh: 原生正轴权重核稳定子的自动发现
theorems.assumptions: Finite row-stochastic ControlPacket; fixed control ports; candidate S6; atom-germ weighted rows
theorems.statement: Accepted positive axis permutations form the stabilizer subgroup. Exhaustive720-candidate search is complete within this row-germ contract. Atomwise retention is stricter. Budgeted search returns a sound subgroup without maximality claim.
theorems.boundary: Not all GL6/signed/control symmetries or all possible state-dependent probabilistic matchings.

theorems.name_zh: 生成元格轨道与首达观察保持
theorems.assumptions: Verified group and exact generator closure; fixed probability law; monitored arrow boundaries
theorems.statement: Generator orbit traversal yields the same canonical lattice as full-group enumeration. Weighted representative compilation preserves all first-HIT/UNKNOWN-time masses and budget bounds.
theorems.boundary: No atom-identity or arbitrary future reweighting guarantee for a fixed-law certificate.

theorems.name_zh: 剪切残差的完整S6对称阶变化
theorems.assumptions: U/V as in note; equal weights1/4 and stop1/2; shear I+2^m E14 with m>=1
theorems.statement: S6 germ stabilizer has order72 through R=m+1 and order4 from R=m+2. Unequal U/V weights reduce the no-shear group to36.
theorems.boundary: Model- and certificate-specific, not a universal world symmetry count.

theorems.name_zh: 六轴随机更新的有限计数商与首达更新律
theorems.assumptions: One-axis integer p-expansion D_i; equal conditional axis probability; continue0<c<=1; threshold2
theorems.statement: Safe active normalized depth subsets reduce from63 to6 count states. With stop,126 safe states reduce to7. First-hit PGF=sum b_j z^j/(1-a z^6), a=c^6*6!/6^6, b_(k+1)=c^(k+1)*(6)_k*k/6^(k+1).
theorems.boundary: No constant-speed six-beat world axiom; no directional control equivalence.
